QF.id: AIFM Fund Monitoring, Reporting, and Exit_16

question.text: Mr. Vikram Desai is Compliance Officer at Aravalli Venture Fund. Per Regulation 20 / Second Amendment 2021, any deviation from SEBI (AIF) Regulations must be independently reported by him to SEBI within:

answer.text: Only at the next quarterly filing

explanation.text: **The Logic:** The Second Amendment 2021 inserted the explicit 7-WORKING-DAY independent reporting obligation on the Compliance Officer. This is a direct-to-SEBI obligation, independent of the manager or trustee, designed to ensure deviations are not suppressed internally. **The Trap:** 24 hours is the stock-exchange disclosure benchmark, not AIF's. 30 days is the CTR review window. 'Next quarter' defeats the purpose of the requirement. **Cross-Exam Context:** III-A/C (Compliance) tests this rule. XIX-C places it in the operational context — what the Compliance Officer's independent escalation path looks like. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Give your Compliance Officer a documented reporting channel and insulate the role from management-fee pressures. A Compliance Officer who double-hats as CFO has an inherent conflict — SEBI inspectors pick up on this immediately.
